summary: The candidate requires a hub Origin and the session CSRF token on the shared device approve/deny handler, provides the CSRF token to the consent page, displays the requesting client, audience, label, and requested lifetime, and adds a cross-origin text/plain regression confirming the device code remains pending.

evidence: src/passport.ts 2026-2034 makes the shared approve/deny handler require an authenticated hub session, its per-session CSRF token, and a hub Origin.

public/device.js 106-111 sends the CSRF token with approve and deny requests, while src/passport.ts 2140-2170 and public/device-view.js 33-45 expose the client, audience, label, and requested lifetime on the consent page.
src/handler_test.ts 3771-3804 adds an end-to-end cross-origin text/plain approval attempt that receives 403 and confirms the attacker-held device code remains pending.
